claims.label: Blake Neff stated TPUSA invitation response was at direction and approval of Erika Kirk
claims.claim: On the Charlie Kirk Show, Blake Neff stated that the invitation-response announcement and all related actions were taken at the request, direction, and approval of Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited Charlie Kirk Show audio segment and any internal TPUSA communications referencing Erika Kirk's approval.

claims.label: Blake Neff stated it is "intuitive" that in-person attendance is critical for authenticity
claims.claim: On the Charlie Kirk Show, Blake Neff stated, "I think it's pretty intuitive that given what is being said ... it's critical to be in person if you want to be authentic and to be detailed."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare this stated rationale against any prior TPUSA live stream format decisions, particularly those involving remote participation.

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff's Prior "Sincere" Phoenix Invitation Did Not Require In-Person Attendance
claims.claim: In his earlier invitation statement, which the host reads aloud, Blake Neff said that if Candace is available TPUSA "would sincerely welcome her participation in that live stream at our studio in Phoenix"; the host says this was not a demand to be there in person.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original December 3 (approx.) Blake Neff statement text and any follow-up communication that added an in-person condition.

claims.label: The Game's released track contains the question "Who really killed Charlie Kirk?"
claims.claim: The Game's song "The Assassination of Candace Owens" (audio excerpt and lyric read) includes the line "Who really killed Charlie Kirk?"
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full released track and verify publication date, distribution platform, and producer credits.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Contact Told Her School Colors Are Green and White, Not Maroon
claims.claim: The host says that when she asked someone at UVU whether the school colors are maroon, he replied that they are green and white.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify UVU official branding (athletics department, university communications) to confirm stated school colors.

claims.label: Host Says UVU September 10 Footage Shows Numerous Young Men Alone Wearing Maroon Shirts
claims.claim: The host says footage from UVU on September 10 shows multiple young men attending alone and wearing maroon shirts.
claims.investigative_direction: Systematically catalog every maroon-shirted attendee visible in publicly available September 10 footage and cross-reference social media profiles.

claims.label: Blake Neff X post states invitation was not guest booking and Candace declined
claims.claim: Blake Neff posted on X that the invitation was "not how you book a guest," that TPUSA "never said that we were" booking a guest, and that Candace "was given the opportunity to join and declined."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original X post with timestamp and any replies; obtain any direct communication records between TPUSA and Candace Owens's representatives.

claims.label: Per Tweet Host Reads, The Charlie Kirk Show Fell to #94 on Apple Podcasts
claims.claim: Per a tweet the host reads, The Charlie Kirk Show has fallen to #94 on Apple Podcasts despite a prior top-10 ranking and a prior #1 placement while Kirk was alive.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference third-party Apple Podcasts tracking services to verify the ranking on the cited date and identify trend pattern.

claims.label: Host Says PBS Featured Emmanuel Bierer as Eyewitness Filmed in Salt Lake City
claims.claim: The host says PBS and other networks featured Emmanuel Bierer as an eyewitness and that he was filmed in Salt Lake City rather than at UVU; she plays a PBS clip of him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original PBS segment, identify the producer/assignment editor, and verify how Bierer was identified as a witness.

claims.label: Host Says Jacob Kasparian Did Not Duck After the Shot Went Off
claims.claim: The host says UVU footage shows Jacob Kasparian remaining upright and not ducking after the shot, briefly handling his phone and walking away.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original full-length footage to confirm the absence of ducking and any subsequent movement.

claims.label: Host Says Footage Shows Jacob Kasparian Recording the Event on His Phone
claims.claim: The host says footage and a grainy superimposed image she shows depict Jacob Kasparian recording the event on his phone.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any phone-recorded footage from Jacob Kasparian or his device via subpoena/preservation order.

claims.label: Jacob Kasparian's earlier-day social media post depicted a different shirt
claims.claim: The host says Jacob Kasparian posted himself earlier on September 10 wearing a dyed blue shirt rather than the maroon shirt worn at UVU.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Facebook post with timestamp metadata; verify whether the timestamp was edited for timezone.

claims.label: Host Says Adam Bartholomew Live-Streamed the Entire UVU Event
claims.claim: The host says Adam Bartholomew live-streamed the entire UVU event on September 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Adam Bartholomew livestream VOD and metadata for forensic review.

claims.label: Host Says Carrie Bartholomew's Tweet Confirms She Was in the Courtyard During the Shot
claims.claim: The host says Carrie Bartholomew posted a photo and a tweet confirming where she was when the shot went off; the tweet the host reads says "When we thought laying in the courtyard that we were about to get shot in the back or in the head". The host separately says Carrie was standing by the bush.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Carrie Bartholomew tweet with image metadata and timestamp.

claims.label: Host Says Adam Bartholomew Did Not Stop Livestreaming to Find His Wife After the Shot
claims.claim: The host says that in his livestream footage Adam Bartholomew did not interrupt the broadcast to check on or locate his wife immediately after the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the full Bartholomew livestream timeline and any subsequent communication regarding his wife's location.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Was Wearing a Maroon Shirt at the Event
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson, the alleged shooter, notoriously was wearing a maroon shirt at the UVU event.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference court filings and law enforcement exhibits confirming Robinson's attire on September 10.

claims.label: Multiple email correspondents state maroon is associated with airborne forces in multiple militaries
claims.claim: In emails the host reads from people she says are past or present military, one writer says airborne forces wear maroon in the UK, the USA, France and dozens of other militaries, and another says undercover police and FBI units often use a "color of the day" or unit color as a signal to others on the same mission.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the email assertions against publicly available military uniform/identifier doctrine for airborne, QRF, and undercover units.

claims.label: Only two videos of the alleged shooter on the roof exist
claims.claim: Per host recollection, there are only two videos showing the alleged shooter on the roof – one from the side showing a crouched figure holding a gun.
claims.investigative_direction: Catalog all publicly known September 10 roof footage and confirm whether additional footage exists in government holdings.

claims.label: Roof video caller did not see subject take the shot and observed no recoil
claims.claim: The host says the individual who shot one of the two roof videos told her in a follow-up call that he did not see the subject take the shot and saw no recoil.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a sworn statement from the roof video caller and any forensic review of the footage.

claims.label: Roof video caller reports no contact from Robinson's defense or federal authorities
claims.claim: The host says the roof video caller told her that Tyler Robinson's defense lawyer had not reached out to him, and that federal authorities had not reached out since she called him.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via court subpoena records and FBI/subpoena logs whether the caller was contacted by either party.

claims.label: Roof video caller reports firearms-instruction background
claims.claim: The host says the roof video caller has experience with guns and teaches people to shoot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the caller's stated qualifications via credentialing records or instructors' registry.

claims.label: Blake Neff Says Erika Kirk Heads This
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Blake Neff says Erika Kirk 'heads this'.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA corporate filings or official communications confirming Erika Kirk's current title and date of appointment.

claims.label: Clip the Host Plays Has Blake Neff Saying TPUSA Response Live Stream Is Set for December 15
claims.claim: In a clip of The Charlie Kirk Show that the host plays, Blake Neff says a TPUSA response live stream is going forward and was announced for December 15 (2025).
claims.investigative_direction: Monitor TPUSA channels for confirmation and document the actual event for artifact capture.

claims.label: Top Comment Says TPUSA Took Three Months to Respond Then Gave 24 Hours
claims.claim: The host reads a top viewer comment saying that TPUSA took three months to respond and then gave the host 24 hours to respond to its invitation.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish from TPUSA's December 3 to 5 posts and the date it first said it would respond whether a 24-hour deadline was ever stated to the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: TPUSA takes them three months to respond. Also TPUSA, you have 24 hours to respond.

claims.label: Caller Gina Says Invitation Tweet Posted at Midnight and Host Saw It Nine Hours Later
claims.claim: Caller Gina tells Blake Neff on the Charlie Kirk Show that, as she understands it, the invitation to the host was tweeted at midnight and the host did not see it until about nine hours later.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the timestamp of Neff's invitation post on X and compare it with when the host first responded publicly.
claims.transcript_snippet: it was issued Blake I think at 12 on a tweet that you had but or midnight 12 not noon midnight and so it was like nine hours later before she even knew

claims.label: Neff Says TPUSA Initially Thought No One Would Believe the Claims
claims.claim: Blake Neff says TPUSA did not address the host's claims for a long time because it initially thought no one would believe a lot of what was said and remembered the friendship Charlie had with her.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with TPUSA's earlier statements and staff messages about whether and when it chose not to respond.
claims.transcript_snippet: we initially just thought no one would believe a lot of what was being said and we also just we we remembered the same friendship that Charlie had

claims.label: Neff Says No Date Was Agreed When He Read the Statement
claims.claim: Blake Neff says that when he read the initial statement on the show TPUSA had not yet agreed on a date and would announce one later.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Wednesday show audio and any internal scheduling messages showing when December 15 was chosen.
claims.transcript_snippet: We actually hadn't agreed on it at the time I read the statement.

claims.label: Neff Says Host Is Free to Attend in Person Once a Date Is Announced
claims.claim: Blake Neff says that once TPUSA announced the date, the host was free to attend in person.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the text of the original Wednesday statement to see whether in-person attendance was stated then.
claims.transcript_snippet: once we announce it Candace is free to attend in person.

claims.label: Neff Says Host Said Name the Time and Place and TPUSA Did
claims.claim: Blake Neff says the host had said "you name the time, you name the place," and that TPUSA did exactly that.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the host's earlier public statement or message using the phrase and compare it with the December announcement.
claims.transcript_snippet: Candace for her part had said you name the time, you name the place. That is what we did.

claims.label: Neff Says Host Had No Difficulty Finding the Scheduled Time
claims.claim: Blake Neff says he does not think the host had any difficulty finding out TPUSA's scheduled time because everyone found it out quite quickly.
claims.investigative_direction: Check whether TPUSA sent the host or her team any direct notice before the public post.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't think she had any difficulty in finding out what our what our scheduled time was. It seems everyone found it out quite quickly.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Was Remote While Neff Said In Person Is Critical
claims.claim: The host says that Andrew Kolvet was live streaming with Blake Neff and was not physically present while Neff said attendance must be in person to be authentic.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch the December 5 Charlie Kirk Show video to confirm whether Kolvet appeared remotely.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's like, "It's not authentic unless it's it's a person is in person and Andrew Kolvet is literally not in person as he's answering his questions."

claims.label: Host Says Her Most Viral Debates Were Never In Person
claims.claim: The host says her most contentious and most viral debates have never been held in person.
claims.investigative_direction: List the host's past debates and their formats to confirm which were remote.
claims.transcript_snippet: My most contentious and my most viral debates have never been in person.

claims.label: Host Says Original Offer Set No In-Person or 24-Hour Requirement
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA's original offer did not make in-person attendance a demand and did not say she had to respond within 24 hours.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the original December 3 statement and TPUSA posts for any mention of an in-person condition or a deadline.
claims.transcript_snippet: They never made in person a point of their demands. Um they never also said that I had to respond within 24 hours.

claims.label: Host Says Her Husband Ruled Out Monday
claims.claim: The host says her husband instantly told her she could not do Monday.
claims.investigative_direction: This rests on the host's own account; confirm only through the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: my husband instantly said, "No, you cannot do this Monday."

claims.label: Neff's Earlier Statement Placed the Live Stream at TPUSA's Phoenix Studio
claims.claim: In the earlier statement the host reads aloud, Blake Neff says TPUSA would sincerely welcome the host's participation in the live stream at its studio in Phoenix.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original statement text and video to verify the wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: If Candace is available, we would sincerely welcome her participation in that live stream at our studio in Phoenix.

claims.label: Host Says Statement Called Critics Antifa Members and Erika Approved It
claims.claim: The host says that, if Erika Kirk approved the statement as Neff stated, it was approved even though it referred to critics as Antifa members.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the statement text and check whether it used the word Antifa for the host's audience.
claims.transcript_snippet: she approved the statement that went out referring to people uh as Antifa members like making us akin to a basket of deplorables

claims.label: Host Says She Would Join Especially If Erika Kirk Is There
claims.claim: The host says she would especially like to make the December event work if Erika Kirk is going to be there, which she calls a game changer.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA whether Erika Kirk was to appear at the December 15 live stream.
claims.transcript_snippet: I would especially like to make this work if you are saying or implying that Erika Kirk is going to be there

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Is on the Road and Not Correcting Tone
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA spokesperson Andrew Kolvet seems to be on the road and is not correcting the attitudes coming out, and that Tyler Bowyer has been late-night tweeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Kolvet's public travel and Bowyer's posts around December 3 to 5.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Kolvet who seems to be on the road and isn't course correcting in the attitudes that are coming out

claims.label: Host Says Her Husband Cannot Make December 15
claims.claim: The host says her husband George shut down the idea that she could make December 15 work immediately and for a valid reason.
claims.investigative_direction: This rests on the host's account; ask TPUSA what flexibility it offered on dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's no way in hell um that George can make the 15th work.

claims.label: Host Says She Believes It Was a Deep State Assassination
claims.claim: The host says she believes the Kirk killing was a deep state assassination and reasons from how the CIA organizes color revolutions abroad.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as the host's stated belief; nothing in this passage is documented evidence.
claims.transcript_snippet: if we believe and know um and have the intuition that this is a deep state assassination, I do.

claims.label: Host Says Ukraine's 2014 Uprising and McCain Were a US Color Revolution
claims.claim: The host asserts that the 2014 Ukrainian uprising against Yanukovich, in which John McCain addressed protesters, was a United States military color revolution rather than an authentic one.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as the host's sweeping historical assertion; assess against documented accounts of the 2013 to 2014 events.
claims.transcript_snippet: when John McCain went over there and led the protesters in the streets, he was really representing the voice of the people. It was not another United States military color revolution.

claims.label: Clip Has McCain Telling Ukrainians It Is Their Moment
claims.claim: A clip the host identifies as John McCain addressing protesters in Ukraine includes the line "People of Ukraine, this is your moment."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source video and date of the McCain speech.
claims.transcript_snippet: People of Ukraine, this is your moment.

claims.label: Host Says the Assassination Was as Organic as McCain Leading Ukraine
claims.claim: The host says she believes the Kirk assassination was about as organic as John McCain leading the people of Ukraine, meaning she believes it was organized.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as the host's belief; the analogy itself is not evidence.
claims.transcript_snippet: that Charlie Kirk's assassination was about as organic as John McCain.

claims.label: Host Says Three Men Shown Alone in Maroon After the Shot
claims.claim: The host says footage shows a young man after the shot, another sitting under a tree after the shot and a third, all alone and wearing maroon, and other men in maroon including one in the bush.
claims.investigative_direction: Catalog each frame the host showed and match the people to named attendees.
claims.transcript_snippet: Show you another person here sitting there under the tree after the shot and he's wearing maroon.

claims.label: Host Says a TikTok User Claimed the FBI Told Him to Delete Family Footage
claims.claim: The host says a TikTok user claimed that someone in his family shot videos of the event and that the FBI asked him to delete the footage after he submitted it, and she says she does not know whether that is true.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the TikTok user and preserve his submission record to the FBI; confirm with him whether a deletion request was made.
claims.transcript_snippet: when he submitted them to the FBI, the FBI had asked him to delete that footage.

claims.label: Host Says the TikTok User Sent Her Footage That Showed Kasparian
claims.claim: The host says that when she got in touch with the same individual he sent her the footage, and her eye gravitated to another man in maroon who was alone and did not duck.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original footage and its metadata from the individual.
claims.transcript_snippet: when I got in touch with this individual and he sent me the footage, my eye immediately gravitated towards another person who happened to be wearing maroon

claims.label: Emailer Says Colors Let Military Observers Know Whom to Protect
claims.claim: The host reads an emailer who says that in coordinated violent scenes people in identifiable colors help military observers know whom to protect or look for.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask military color-marking experts whether identifier colors are used this way; the emailer is unnamed.
claims.transcript_snippet: especially in coordinated violent scenes, uh, making sure that people are in certain colors or in something that is identifiable is important so that military men can observe who to protect or who they're looking for

claims.label: Host Says She Does Not Think Kasparian Shot Kirk
claims.claim: The host says she does not think Jacob Kasparian shot Charlie Kirk and that she is only observing things she finds unusual.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the host's later statements about Kasparian.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do not think he shot Harley Charlie Kirk

claims.label: Host Says Kasparian Attended the Event Alone
claims.claim: The host says it is unusual that Jacob Kasparian attended the event alone.
claims.investigative_direction: Review crowd footage for companions of Kasparian.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's unusual that he attended the event alone.

claims.label: Host Says Kasparian's Facebook Post Was at 8:42 or 7:42 a.m.
claims.claim: The host says Kasparian's earlier Facebook post of himself in a different shirt is stamped either 8:42 a.m. or 7:42 a.m., and she is unsure whether Facebook adjusted the time zone.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original post with metadata to settle which time applies and the time zone.
claims.transcript_snippet: he had posted himself earlier that day at either 8:42 a. m. or 7:42 a. m.

claims.label: Host Says Kasparian Moved from High Ground to a Lower Rung Before the Shot
claims.claim: The host says Kasparian was up high on the campus and was at a lower rung two minutes before Charlie Kirk was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Track Kasparian's position through crowd footage in the two minutes before 12:23.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's up high. Um and then he's at the lower rung 2 minutes before Charlie gets shot.

claims.label: Host Says Kasparian's Family Posted Nothing About the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says none of Kasparian's family members posted anything about the assassination that she could find, even though he is active online and it happened in their backyard.
claims.investigative_direction: Social media audit; absence of posts is weak evidence about a private family.
claims.transcript_snippet: None of his family members posted anything about Charlie's assassination. He is active.

claims.label: Host Suspects Maroon Boys Were Tasked with Filming from Set Angles
claims.claim: The host says she is beginning to suspect that the maroon-shirted men in general were tasked with taking footage from predetermined angles, and calls it a suspicion that may be wrong.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify each maroon-shirted attendee and test whether their footage coincides with key angles.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am beginning to suspect that our maroon boys in general were tasked with taking footage from predetermined angles.

claims.label: Host Says She Never Said Anything About Bartholomew Before
claims.claim: The host says she had never said anything about Adam Bartholomew, had only reviewed his footage, and that online users were clocking him as suspicious.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the host's earlier episodes for any mention of Bartholomew.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have never ever said anything about Adam Bartholomew. I have reviewed his footage, but people online were clocking him as suspicious.

claims.label: Host Says Carrie Bartholomew Stood Almost Directly Near Kasparian
claims.claim: The host says she learned by accident that Adam Bartholomew's wife Carrie was at the event, standing by the bush almost directly near Kasparian.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate both people in the same frame of the footage and photo.
claims.transcript_snippet: his wife Carrie was there and she was standing by the bush actually almost directly near Jacob Kasparian.

claims.label: Host Says All Footage Came from Maroon Boys and Was Algorithmically Boosted
claims.claim: The host says she thinks all of the footage has come from the maroon-shirted men and that a lot of it was then algorithmically boosted.
claims.investigative_direction: Map the earliest uploads of the main videos to the accounts of the people in maroon.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think all of our footage has come from Maroon Boys and a lot of that footage uh was then algorithmically boosted.

claims.label: Host Asks Viewers to Identify the Maroon Men at more tips
claims.claim: The host asks viewers who recognize the maroon-shirted men she showed to email more tips (transcribed as 'candens.com'), and says she does not want general thoughts on the color.
claims.investigative_direction: Reconcile tips received with the host's later identifications.
claims.transcript_snippet: if you recognize these individuals in particular, more tips candens. com.

claims.label: Host Says Bierer Is a Former Oracle Engineer Believed from Germany
claims.claim: The host says Emmanuel Bierer is a former employee of Oracle, a software engineer, and she believes from Germany.
claims.investigative_direction: Check public professional profiles for Bierer's employer history and location.
claims.transcript_snippet: he's a former employee of Oracle. He's in engineering. Uh, I believe he's from Germany from what I looked into.

claims.label: Host Says She Sees No Photos of Bierer at the Event
claims.claim: The host says Bierer attended the event but that she does not see any photos of him there, and asks viewers for footage showing him.
claims.investigative_direction: Request footage from attendees who recognize Bierer.
claims.transcript_snippet: he attended the event but somehow I don't see any photos of him at the event

claims.label: Host Says Barker Said Her Friendship Got the Early News Hit
